reason: A user-interface navigation plugin that adds an accessible minimap for navigating conversation turns, with previews, status indicators, and on-demand older-history loading.

summaries.zh: 为对话界面添加可访问的缩略导航栏，支持查看回合预览、状态和生成文件路径，并快速跳转到指定回合。
summaries.en: Adds an accessible conversation minimap with turn previews, status indicators, produced file paths, and quick navigation to selected turns.

capabilities: Displays a conversation minimap with one interactive marker per turn
Shows turn summaries, status, and optional produced file paths from the conversation snapshot
Scrolls to selected conversation turns and requests older history on demand
Uses scoped observers, event listeners, portal rendering, and accessibility controls
